dataDefinition.source: locally collected OKX public REST snapshots
dataDefinition.sampling: approximately 65 seconds; each snapshot contains a book and the latest 100 trades
dataDefinition.limitation: not a lossless websocket event stream; latency stress is mandatory

strategyDefinition.factors: 5/10-level depth imbalance, latest-trade imbalance, and normalized top-of-book OFI
strategyDefinition.execution: marketable bid/ask, per-side taker fee and adverse slippage
strategyDefinition.positioning: one position per instrument, fixed fraction of current equity, no leverage
strategyDefinition.exit: executable-quote take profit, stop loss, or maximum holding snapshots
strategyDefinition.timing: signals use only the current or earlier completed snapshot

decision.rule: 验证期望必须为正；BTC/ETH 在测试、成本压力和延迟一张快照时都必须盈利；测试 PF 不低于 1.10，实际胜率至少高于盈亏平衡胜率 2 个百分点，每个标的不少于30笔交易，最差回撤不超过3%。
